features.description: show every machine and whether it is free, running, done, or out of order

complaints.missing: Spin Cycle Status doesn't even list the machines. What is it for.
complaints.down: Spin Cycle Status just says "Failed to fetch". Walked over anyway. All busy.

complaints.six_of_eight: Spin Cycle Status shows 6 machines. There are 8.
complaints.done_as_free: Spin Cycle Status said a machine was free. Someone's wet laundry was still in it.

complaints.failed_fetch: Spin Cycle Status shows no machines at all. Walked over anyway. All busy.

complaints.missing: Spin Cycle Status never updates. It shows the same thing all day.

complaints.no_refresh: Spin Cycle Status said 4 machines free. Walked over, all 4 running. The page hadn't updated since the morning.
complaints.fetch_all_free: Spin Cycle Status said every machine was free. None were.
